HowItWorks.title: How QRBid works
HowItWorks.description: Three simple steps to create an auction, share it with interested people, and receive bids online.

1.label: STEP 01
1.title: Create your auction
1.description: Add a title, description, photos, starting price, minimum bid increment, and end date.
1.footer: Set the rules for your auction

2.label: STEP 02
2.title: Share the QR code
2.description: Share a direct link or place a QR code on a printed A4 poster so interested people can open your auction.

3.label: STEP 03
3.title: Receive bids
3.description: Registered participants can place bids online. Follow the current highest bid and see when the auction ends.
